bundle.text:
# dsh-agent-teams bundle patch: mounts the agent-teams plugin into the host
# composition of a dsh profile. The plugin registers its `agent_teams_*` tools
# into the shared `tools` registry and one usage section into the global
# system prompt, so every session of the profile can drive AgentTeams through
# natural language ("用 AgentTeams 做 X").
#
# Install: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <this package>` (npm or a local
# path). The `dsh plugin` command pnpm-installs the package into the profile
# and reconciles it into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer list.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-super-agent
      # Node-resolvable package name — must stay in sync with package.json
      # `name`. The npm name is the scoped `@eternalnight/agent-bot`, and the
      # plugin id above is the stable identity used by routes, message sources
      # and stored state, so it intentionally keeps its historical value.
      name: '@eternalnight/agent-bot'
      config:
        # Team state lives under `<session workspace>/<stateDir>/<teamId>/`
        # (team.json + inbox/*.jsonl mailboxes).
        stateDir: .agent-teams
        # Provider used to spawn member subagents ('spawn' or 'fork').
        memberProvider: spawn

Run the pet from source:powershell .\desktop-pet\start-pet.cmd & "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe" desktop-pet\pet.py --workspace . python desktop-pet\pet.py --check --workspace . ``` > Runs for real (2026-11-05): `pet.py --check --workspace .` exits 0 with `{"ok": true, "level": 2, "stage": "fry", "frames": 16, ...}` (`completedTasks` follows finished work, so it is not pinned). ---

DELIVERY GATES

| Signal | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Full suite | `pnpm verify` exits 0 |
| Browser-side contract | `pnpm verify:web-routes` passes |
| Release artifact | Package smoke test checks runtime and support QR codes, excludes source / tests / docs |
| A real team run | Captain dispatches → members write → independent review → synthesis (covered by the full suite) |
| Isolation | An implementer cannot approve its own implementation |
This is a tool for **parallel wall-clock time plus independent verification**, not a promise that every task gets cheaper; for small tasks a single agent is usually the better deal.

| Option | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoVerify` | `true` | The host re-runs every declared `verify` command before accepting a finished quality task |
| `autoReview` | `false` | Completes ready review tasks automatically once gates, acceptance and host commands pass |
| `requireAcceptance` | `true` | Automatic review requires every acceptance item of the reviewed task to pass |
| `autoDetect` | `true` | Detects the generated project's own `package.json` test / typecheck scripts and runs them too |
| `reviewMode` | `"auto"` | `auto`: the host closes it; `human`: stops at “awaiting human review” |
| `commands` | `["git diff --check"]` | Fallback verify commands for generated projects |
| `commandsByProject` | `{}` | Verify commands per project root |
| `verifyTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Host timeout per verify command |

```yaml quality: autoReview: true reviewMode: "human" # stop at “awaiting human review” after the host passes commandsByProject: ---

ROLES & TEMPLATES

Lineups are picked by “what happens next”; the seat cap is 5, and idle roles spend no tokens. Six task lineups ship today (defined in `src/client/lineup-store.ts`, display names from `src/agency-role-seeds.ts`):

| Lineup | Roles (id → display name) | Good for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Direct delivery** | `product-manager` PM · `engineering-senior-developer` senior developer · `testing-evidence-collector` evidence collector · `engineering-code-reviewer` code reviewer | Fewest detours, straight to the task |
| **Bug fix** | `engineering-codebase-onboarding-engineer` onboarding engineer · `engineering-senior-developer` senior developer · `testing-evidence-collector` evidence collector | Understand the code, then locate and fix |
| **Full-stack feature** | `product-manager` PM · `engineering-frontend-developer` frontend developer · `engineering-backend-architect` backend architect · `testing-evidence-collector` evidence collector · `engineering-code-reviewer` code reviewer | Contract first, front and back in parallel (all 5 seats) |
| **Read-only audit** | `engineering-codebase-onboarding-engineer` onboarding engineer · `engineering-code-reviewer` code reviewer · `testing-evidence-collector` evidence collector · `engineering-technical-writer` technical writer | Touch nothing, only gather evidence |
| **Performance** | `product-manager` PM · `engineering-senior-developer` senior developer · `te

Six mode presets are generated from development modes as well, plus twelve founding templates: **direct delivery / bug fix / new feature / research / audit / full-stack / hardening / build / refactor / docs / design review / short drama**. Every role gets a fixed contract: ownership, must / must-not, done criteria, a five-point report and a budget. The full-stack lineup keeps all 5 seats on purpose: one less handoff. ---

BOUNDARIES

- No hidden cloud sync: growth and feedback diagnostics stay local. - Approval is explicit: a plan draft starts nothing before you approve it. - Deployment needs a clear confirmation: agents never quietly replace a running session. - Review is independent: an implementer cannot approve its own implementation. ---

DEVELOPMENT

```powershell pnpm install pnpm typecheck pnpm build pnpm verify After a fresh clone run `pnpm build` before `pnpm verify`: `lib/client/` intermediates and `*.map` files are generated and stay out of git. DSH lifecycle skills are resolved live from the shared memory vault and are not vendored here. ---
